# db-26 — DataBall wide CSV appends must apply the CSV schema before merging

Appending a CSV with a unit header (`Gain(dB)`) to a wide session that already has `Gain` throws `Duplicate canonical column 'Gain' from header 'Gain(dB)'`.

The cause: a wide session applies the CSV schema (header canonicalization, configured types, metadata extraction) to the whole `"data"` table *after* the merge (`ImportCsvWithSchema`, `src/DataBall/DataBall.cs`). The raw header `Gain(dB)` therefore lands as a new column next to `Gain`, and canonicalizing it collides. Layout sessions already apply the schema to staging before routing.

**Findings:** db-22 relay (pre-existing on 7c17c59), owner 2026-10-11 · **Size:** M · **Tree:** databall

**Not in this slice:** schema merge and widening rules (db-23); many-file opens (db-11).

## Why

Found during the db-22 relay and confirmed on base 7c17c59. Owner, 2026-10-11: track it separately from db-23 to keep db-23 small. db-11 opens many CSVs and will hit this, so db-11 depends on this item.

**Model note:** Claude-only. The implementer is Sonnet 5.5 at high effort, because CSV schema ordering is subtle.

**Verify first, in spec review:**

- whether applying the schema on staging changes wide-session behavior that README "Differences from a wide session" documents.
